sonnet.problem: Card 1 says the council already said Jesus deserves to die (Matthew 26:66). That gives away the answer to card 2, which asks what the chief priests and elders plan to do (put Him to death).
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The True statement (the silver can't go into the treasury) just repeats what story card 11 said one card earlier. The only new piece is the 'blood money' reason.
sonnet.rule: A True statement never just repeats the card before it.

sonnet.problem: The answer 'Blood' was already given on earlier cards: 'blood money' in the card 12 question and 'innocent blood' in card 7. That gives away the later fill-in-the-blank answer.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The card says 'All of this fulfills what was spoken through Jeremiah' and that the line 'ties it all together'. Verse 9 says only that what was spoken through Jeremiah was fulfilled. It doesn't say what 'all of this' covers, so the card stretches the text and decides how the two things connect.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.
